Excellent! Now I have all the information needed to calculate the surface energy:

1. Bulk energy (Ebulk) = -1679.86275357967 eV
2. Slab energy (Eslab) = -1631.81097242536 eV
3. Number of atoms in bulk (Nbulk) = 500
4. Surface area (A) = 20.19465 Å × 20.19465 Å = 407.82583 Å²

The surface energy formula is:
γ = (Eslab - N*Ebulk/Nbulk)/(2A)

Since we have the same number of atoms in both systems (N = Nbulk = 500), the formula simplifies to:
γ = (Eslab - Ebulk)/(2A)

Calculating:
γ = (-1631.81097242536 - (-1679.86275357967))/(2 * 407.82583)
γ = (48.05178115431)/(815.65166)
γ = 0.0589137 eV/Å²
